# Language Adapter

## Rules
- `LanguageAdapter` = stateless sync deterministic interface. Required core: `languages()`, `extensions()`, `resolutionManifests()`, `analyzeFile`, `resolveImports`, `buildRelations`. Optional cohesive facets (all-or-nothing): `packageResolution`, `relativeImportResolution`, `qualifiedNameResolution`, `symbolReferenceSyntax`, `reExportLinking`. Facet presence declares full service; no partial facets; no language/extension/manifest compensation branches. `capabilities()`/`declarationPolicy()` distinct from facets.
- `resolutionManifests()` returns exact basenames (empty OK if none), no I/O, names every manifest actually used. TypeScript returns `["package.json"]`.
- `analyzeFile(filePath, content, context)` parses once → complete compact `FileAnalysisDraft`: symbols, imports, deterministic binding/call facts, optional `qualifiedReferenceFacts`, namespace, optional serializable parser state. Never retain AST/parser trees/heavyweight runtime. Parser-owned native/WASM resources register in `IndexSession` parser-resource scope immediately after parse with disposal; released at file-epoch end even on throw. Post-return data must not reference registered resources.
- `resolveImports`/`buildRelations` consume stored facts + `IndexSession`; no content reread, reparse, whole-symbol scans, or per-candidate FS probes. Indexer derives file `IMPORTS`; adapters emit deterministic concrete relations or proven loader imports. `DEPENDS_ON` = spec-only.
- All core/facet methods sync, deterministic, side-effect-free outside session. Only `packageResolution.identity` and `packageResolution.prepare` MAY I/O. Compact run-scoped cache via `IndexSession`.
- Registry builds language/extension maps dynamically; validates atomically; throws `SpecdError` code `INVALID_LANGUAGE_ADAPTER` for invalid core/declarations/manifests/facets. Later registration replaces matching languages/extensions; orphaned adapters leave `getAdapters()`. Unknown extensions skip silently.
- Facet absence → behaviour unresolved, no heuristic/error; absent `packageResolution` listed once in `importDiagnostics.adaptersWithoutPackageResolution`. Facet failure isolated: per-file errors local; `identity`/`prepare`/`link` failure disables package-addressed behaviour for adapter, drops solely claimed identities, preserves independent relative `reExportLinking`.
- `packageResolution`: `identity` searches usable manifest from canonical `codeRoot` upward bounded by VCS `repoRoot` (or codeRoot-only if no VCS); `prepare` once post-Pass1 pre-imports; `matchSpecifier`/`entrySurface` pure from prepared data. Manifests: TS `package.json`/`name`; Python `pyproject.toml`/`[project].name` only; Go `go.mod`/`module`; PHP `composer.json`/`name`. Project root ≠ code root ≠ package root. Ask every facet-providing adapter per workspace; cross-workspace same-name ambiguity → no workspace + error; same workspace multi-adapter OK.
- `relativeImportResolution.resolve` pure candidate file ids; caller keeps indexed only.
- `qualifiedNameResolution`: pure `build`; `resolveToPath` from session metadata only, no FS.
- `symbolReferenceSyntax`: pure parse→owner-then-member candidates; render generic + optional native. Dynamic/ambiguous unresolved. Canonical/structured requests bypass parser; shared domain never splits `.`.
- `reExportLinking.link` after all Pass1 + prepare, before Pass2 imports. Relative via relative facet; package via same entry surface as imports. Binding surface = re-exporting file; target = already-published logical ID incl. cross-workspace. Unresolved/ambiguous → no guessed binding.
- `ImportResolutionContext` exposes generic `packageEntryFiles`/`resolvePackageExport`. Export resolves only when all requested spaces/entries agree on one logical target; reasons: `facet-absent`, `package-unknown`, `no-entry-surface`, `not-exported`, `ambiguous`. Never first/unique same-name workspace symbol. Persist steps; diagnostics non-persisted. External `package-unknown` counts only in `externalPackageImports`.
- Qualified refs resolve in `resolveImports` only when qualifier is namespace from resolved package import, unshadowed, and `resolvePackageExport` hits. Emit `CALLS`/`CONSTRUCTS`/`USES_TYPE` by kind; drop unresolved/absent `sourceSymbolId` silently; helper failures not indexing failures.
- Parser-authoritative extraction from parser nodes; regex/text only for unsupported constructs or manifest metadata. Strings/comments never create facts. Unsupported/ambiguous/runtime → no fact or explicit unresolved.
- Calls: innermost callable caller via shared half-open containment (line+column); proven local/import/receiver/session callee. Drop top-level, ambiguous, dynamic, runtime/reflection/container, monkey-patch, interprocedural. No private nearest-preceding/line-only selector.
- Capability flags truthfully describe shared facts + ordered provenance for declarations/members/bindings/hierarchy/build context. Unsupported → coverage gap; generic resolver never guesses or receives adapter syntax.
- Member-capable adapter establishes logical owner before member identity, emits `MemberSemantics`, sets lexical occurrence `parentId` with strict scope popping. Top-level no owner; same-name under distinct owners stay distinct.
- Declaration policy classifies each role: logical+physical, lexical binding, physical-only, or unsupported using role/scope/visibility/owner/language semantics; broad `SymbolKind` insufficient.
- Hierarchy support emits consistent facts, ordered provenance, resolvable `EXTENDS`/`IMPLEMENTS`/`OVERRIDES`; unsupported precedence/build/dynamic → gap, never guesses.
- Every symbol: parser-derived half-open complete construct range + contained exact `selectionRange`; omit untrustworthy candidate and report gap.
- Bounded per-file analysis: reuse owner/scope/callable evidence once; no per-member recursive owner walk, per-ref scope body walk, or per-call full-symbol sort. Optimization preserves identities/ordering/ranges/parents/facts/relations.
- Built-in TS/JS, Python, Go, PHP pass reusable conformance suite: ranges, caller containment, scope isolation, logical owners, declaration grouping, physical-only facts, multi-occurrence resolution, coverage after impact, unresolved-import safety, hierarchy provenance, no post-prepare metadata reads, clean/incremental equivalence. Language specs MAY tighten, never weaken.
- Adding language = adapter implementation/registration/spec/docs only: core, truthful capabilities/policy, complete supported facets, exact manifests, validate registration, pass conformance. No indexer/session/resolver/store change. `docs/code-graph/language-adapters.md` mirrors contract.

## Constraints
- Interface, not abstract class; no shared mutable adapter state.
- Core + optional all-or-nothing facets; decide from facet presence only.
- Plain compact parser/session state only; no retained AST/parser runtime.
- No `@specd/core` dependency.
- No language-specific indexer resolution logic, fuzzy/runtime inference, or Pass 2 filesystem probing.
- Dynamic/unresolvable calls, loaders, includes, imports, hierarchy targets drop without guessed graph relation.
- Tree-sitter/ast-grep queries remain private.
- TypeScript adapter registered by default.
